messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["axolotl", "pangolin"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A stout four-legged creature shown in three-quarter view facing right. It has pale pink moist-looking wrinkled skin on the head, neck, sides, underside and limbs, with a broad flat rounded snout, large prominent eyes, small nostrils and a slight smiling mouth. Feathery reddish external gills protrude from the sides of the head and neck. The arched back, upper sides and top of the rear are covered in dense overlapping large brown scales. It stands on four short sturdy limbs ending in broad splayed clawed feet, and has a thick tapering tail extending to the left rear and partially out of frame.", "extra_limb_pieces": 6, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "broad flat pale pink amphibian-like head with rounded snout", "part": "head", "where": "at the front right of the body"}, {"looks_like": "large round dark eyes with pale blue-grey rings", "part": "eyes", "where": "on the sides of the head"}, {"looks_like": "two tiny pink dots", "part": "nostrils", "where": "on the front of the snout"}, {"looks_like": "thin straight to slightly upturned line", "part": "mouth", "where": "across the front and sides of the snout"}, {"looks_like": "six feathery reddish-brown stalks with fine filaments, three per side", "part": "gills", "where": "protruding outward and backward from the sides of the head and neck behind the eyes"}, {"looks_like": "dense overlapping large rounded brown keratinous scales with fine texture", "part": "scales", "where": "covering the arched back and upper sides from behind the gills to the tail"}, {"looks_like": "pale pink wrinkled skin with transverse folds", "part": "torso skin", "where": "on the lower sides, underside and neck below the scaled back"}, {"looks_like": "short stout pale pink wrinkled limbs", "part": "legs", "where": "two under the front chest and two under the rear belly"}, {"looks_like": "broad splayed feet with five slender toes tipped with small dark claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the ends of the four legs on the ground"}, {"looks_like": "thick tapering tail, pale and wrinkled below with scales on top", "part": "tail", "where": "extending to the left rear, partially cropped out of the picture"}, {"looks_like": "fine darker speckled mottling", "part": "markings", "where": "on the top and sides of the head"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
